skill.summary: Add Catalyst-Relay HTTP endpoints with schemas, handlers, route registration, client mapping, and docs.

security_audit.summary: All static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, TypeScript examples, a relative import, and a generic validation error string. content.value_statement: Creating Catalyst-Relay routes requires consistent schemas, handlers, registration, and docs. This skill guides endpoint structure, Hono wiring, response envelopes, client mapping, and documentation.
actual_capabilities: Defines the expected route file pattern for Catalyst-Relay endpoints.
Shows colocated Zod request schemas, response types, and handler factories.
Explains how to register handlers with the Hono application.
Documents the standard success and error response envelope.
Maps HTTP endpoints to ADTClient library methods when needed.
Lists required endpoint documentation sections and a completion checklist.
limitations: It is specific to Catalyst-Relay project conventions.
It does not create files or run commands by itself.
It does not define authentication or authorization policy.
It requires the user to provide endpoint behavior and domain rules.

use_cases.title: Create a New API Route
use_cases.description: Add a Catalyst-Relay endpoint with a schema, handler, response type, and route registration.

use_cases.title: Standardize Endpoint Documentation
use_cases.description: Prepare endpoint docs with request details, response fields, errors, examples, and use cases.

use_cases.title: Align HTTP and Library APIs
use_cases.description: Connect a new endpoint to an ADTClient method when the route wraps reusable core functionality.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Basic Endpoint
prompt_templates.prompt: Use add-endpoint to plan a new endpoint for [resource]. Include the route file, schema, handler, registration, and docs checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Add Validation and Errors
prompt_templates.prompt: Use add-endpoint to design [method] [path]. Include required request fields, validation failures, success output, and machine-readable error codes.

prompt_templates.title: Connect a Client Method
prompt_templates.prompt: Use add-endpoint to add [method] [path] and map it to an ADTClient method. Include route wiring and documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Endpoint Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use add-endpoint to plan related endpoints for [feature]. Group route files, shared schemas, client methods, error codes, and docs sections.

output_examples.input: Add a login endpoint with request validation and a client method.
output_examples.output: A route plan covering the route file, request schema, handler factory, Hono registration, ADTClient mapping, response envelope, and documentation tasks.

output_examples.input: Document a packages endpoint after adding the handler.
output: Request body and response field tables.
Error code list, use cases, and library usage notes.

best_practices: Keep schemas, response types, and handlers close to each endpoint.
Return consistent success and error envelopes from every handler.
Update route registration, client methods, and docs in the same change.
anti_patterns: Adding a handler without request validation.
Returning ad hoc response shapes from different endpoints.
Skipping documentation after changing the public API surface.

faq.question: What projects is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for Catalyst-Relay projects that use TypeScript, Hono routes, Zod validation, and ADTClient library mappings.

faq.question: Does it generate endpoint files automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance that an AI coding agent or developer can apply in the repository.

faq.question: Does it cover request validation?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs users to colocate a Zod request schema with each route handler.

faq.question: Does it include response conventions?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents a consistent success envelope and a standard error envelope with a machine-readable code.

faq.question: When should I update ADTClient?
faq.answer: Update ADTClient when the endpoint wraps reusable core functionality that should also be available in library mode.

faq.question: What documentation should be added?
faq.answer: Add endpoint docs with request fields, response fields, examples, error codes, use cases, and library usage notes.
